scope: Two-layer municipal geospatial onboarding and assurance pack: schema/CRS mapping, complete reconciliation and exceptions, GeoPackage, map, provenance, executable acceptance, handoff and one bounded correction/update. No survey certification, source-owner fact resolution, field verification or procurement award.
source_status: Evidence-anchored cost simulation. Wages and API unit rates sourced; hours, token use, demand, buyer behavior, quality, costs, collections and capacity are scenario assumptions. Actual service receipts 0; actual complete authoring cost unknown.

human.note: Composite load includes benefits, employer costs and nonbillable business time once. Separate service margin is a pricing assumption, not overhead. Four-hour and eight-hour incumbent challenges are mandatory.

inference.note: Token totals include reasoning output; per-request context remains below long-context threshold. Independent checks are not claimed statistically independent model judgments.

A.note: All costs are CAD scenario estimates. No compulsory manual review or onboarding. Unpaid unsuccessful attempts incur their delivery costs. Launch configuration is A; optional extraction/Gym are not billed again here.

B.note: Originating code development already included in A. B records only incremental assessment/extraction/sharing/maintenance. Initial assessment is charged even when retention is declined.

C.note: Optional scenario budget, not required for baseline profitability and not actual historical expenditure.

market.note: No real prospect/customer/quote is represented. Each invitation is an eligible distinct scoped job; existing scripts/in-house work and no purchase are outside options. Capacity is finite. No price change keeps demand artificially fixed.

confirmation.interval_definition: 5th-95th percentiles of simulated annual outcomes, not empirical confidence intervals or probabilities of real business success.
confirmation.revision: Final reporting/accounting corrections; original v1 freeze and outcomes preserved. Price family and central economic assumptions unchanged. Reference sensitivity keeps buyer value and budgets fixed in CAD.
